subject.title: Feature: fallbackChannel for hook mappings when primary delivery fails

question: Should hook delivery support ordered automatic cross-channel retries after a primary send failure, with every alternate explicitly specifying channel, recipient, account, and optional thread?
rationale: The request adds public configuration and changes privacy-sensitive routing, replay, and duplicate-delivery semantics that cannot be safely selected from source behavior alone.

options.title: Explicit destination chain
options.body: Add ordered fully bound destinations to the canonical delivery contract and retry only failures classified as safe to replay.

options.title: Failure notification only
options.body: Keep one content destination and notify a separate failure destination without replaying the hook output.

options.title: No automatic retry
options.body: Keep single-target delivery and improve provider recovery and failure diagnostics instead.

recommendation.title: Explicit destination chain
recommendation.body: Add ordered fully bound destinations to the canonical delivery contract and retry only failures classified as safe to replay.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current and historical trail across hook ingress, delivery contracts, and prior issue review points here for the product choice.
